specials.title: Red Dog Piney Creek Specials
specials.description:
Appetizer
Pork Sliders ... 13
3 brioche slider buns, loaded with our slow cooked pulled pork in a vinegar based sauce; topped with housemade coleslaw.

Entrées:
Chicken Satay ... 25
Chicken thighs marinated in coconut milk, skewered and grilled, on a bed of mildly spicy peanut sauced linguine noodles. Garnished with snow peas, shaved carrots and cucumbers.

Pan Seared Rainbow Trout ... 27
Trout, seasoned with Italian herbs then pan seared in garlic lemon butter sauce, served with fingerling potatoes and grilled asparagus.

Dessert:
Strawberry Fool ... 10
Sliced strawberries layed with lemon curd. An old English favorite, smooth, tart and sweet, served with fresh whipped cream.

LUNCH SPECIALS
Friday & Saturday 11 AM-3 PM

Hot Italian Hero/Sub ... 16
Sliced pastrami, salami, Black Forest ham and provolone topped with lettuce, tomato, onion tossed in our housemade red wine vinaigrette and hot cherry peppers. Served with fries.

Kyler's Jalapeño-Onion Smashburger ... 16
Our signature beef blend, smashed and topped with grilled jalapeños, onions and a smidge of house BBQ sauce. Topped with pepper jack cheese on a toasteed brioche bun with Red Dog burger sauce, lettuce and tomato.

specials.title: Red Dog Bar & Bistro Piney Creek Specials
specials.description:
Appetizer
Shrimp Ceviche ... 15
Shrimp - poached, diced and marinated in lime
juice with onions, tomatoes, avocados and cilantro.
Served with crispy fried tortilla chips.

Entrées
Seared Ahi Tuna Rice Bowl ... 32
Sushi-grade Ahi tuna, seared and sliced, over a
bed of seasoned rice, with steamed edamame,
carrots and creamy avocado. Garnished with
seaweed salad and pickled ginger, then drizzled
with spicy mayo dressing.

Chicken Curry ... 24
Roasted pulled chicken in a mild creamy
coconut curry sauce; served over rice.

Dessert:
Strawberry Fool ... 10
Sliced strawberries layered with lemon curd.
An old English favorite - smooth, tart and sweet.
Served with whipped cream.

LUNCH SPECIALS
Friday & Saturday 11 AM-3 PM
Grilled Chicken Salad ... 15
Grilled chicken breast, cheddar cheese, tomato, cucumber and croutons on mixed greens with your choice of dressing.

Fried Chicken/Bacon Ranch Sandwich ... 14
Buttermilk, dill pickle-brined chicken breast, battered and fried. Topped with provolone cheese, lettuce, tomato and Ranch dressing. Served on a toasted bun with fries.
